segments.text: Pakistan or Bangladesh. Three rounds. Who has more people?
Round two. Whose workers abroad send more money home? Pakistan or Bangladesh?
Pakistan. By almost seven billion dollars.
Final round. Whose economy is bigger? Pakistan or Bangladesh?
Bangladesh. By forty-nine billion dollars. With eighty million fewer people.
Pakistan or Bangladesh? Comment your flag.
